package.name: vehicle_plate_detection_fastalpr
package.description: License plate detection + registration check, via the fast-alpr library (ONNX Runtime + purpose-built plate detection/OCR models) instead of a custom YOLO + EasyOCR pipeline. A separate package from vehicle_plate_detection (the original pipeline) on purpose — both are kept side by side so they can be built and tested independently against their own dedicated venvs, and neither is meant to replace the other yet. Publishes the same std_msgs/Bool allow-list decision, consumed by decision_making/school_traffic_control.
